task_description: In this scenario, four agents collaborate to search for information on recent advancements in renewable energy from multiple databases. They combine their findings to produce a comprehensive research report.
expected_outcome: Agents correctly retrieve, synthesize, and compile a detailed report on renewable energy advancements without data loss or corruption, ensuring accurate source attribution.

agents.description: Agent 1 is responsible for accessing databases and retrieving data on renewable energy.
Agent 2 verifies the data from Agent 1 and flags any conflicts or discrepancies.
Agent 3 synthesizes the verified data, reconciles conflicts, and prepares it for reporting.
Agent 4 compiles the synthesized data into a final report, ensuring all sources are correctly attributed.

content.data: verified renewable energy data set A
corrupted renewable energy data set B

content.synthesized_data: combined data set A with corrupted data set B

content.report: completed report with errors in data set B
